WITH stage_0 AS (
  SELECT class_uid, "device.hostname", message, "metadata.log_source", "metadata.uid", "process.name", time FROM __nano_lake_source__
  WHERE time >= '2026-09-24 07:00:00.000000' AND time < '2026-09-25 07:01:00.000000'
  AND (((class_uid = 1007) AND lower("metadata.log_source") != 'audit'))
),
stage_1 AS (
  SELECT "process.name" AS "process.name", uniqExact("device.hostname") AS h
  FROM stage_0
  GROUP BY "process.name"
),
stage_2 AS (
  SELECT * FROM stage_1
  WHERE h < 50
),
stage_3 AS (
  SELECT * FROM stage_2
  ORDER BY h ASC, "process.name" ASC
),
stage_4 AS (
  SELECT * FROM stage_3
  LIMIT 20
)
SELECT * FROM stage_4 LIMIT 501 SETTINGS max_threads=16, max_execution_time=300, optimize_read_in_order=0, optimize_aggregation_in_order=0
